HYPE.summary: Fundamentals lean positive for the long: Hyperliquid still earns about two-thirds of perp DEX fees and its treasury company keeps buying HYPE and expanded its buyback to $100M. Against that, its RWA perp share is slipping and the monthly core-contributor unlock lands Nov 6 (size not disclosed; October's was 3.75M HYPE). Mixed overall, with price sitting at the long's zone.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies raises its share buyback from $30M to $100M, extended to Oct 2027
Hyperliquid takes about 67.6% of all perp DEX fees over the past 30 days ($84.6M)
Hyperliquid's share of RWA perp volume falls from about 80% to 26% as Binance and OKX compete

unlocks.note: Core contributors, monthly unlock on the 6th (Oct batch was 3.75M HYPE; some calendars list a larger figure)

COMP.summary: This week's news leans bullish, which works against the short: COMP jumped about 27% on Oct 20 with no clear catalyst, and Compound launched on Unichain with five new collateral assets. No vesting unlocks; nearly all COMP is already circulating.

news.title: COMP jumps about 27% in a day, outpacing BTC and ETH, while Compound TVL stays below September levels
Compound goes live on Unichain with wstETH, weETH, ezETH, BTC and UNI as collateral

MORPHO.summary: New integrations support the long: Robinhood stock tokens as collateral and Ledger loans built on Morpho. A risk is about 973K MORPHO stolen from two institution-linked wallets and sent to Tornado Cash, which could be sold. No cliff unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Robinhood stock tokens go live as collateral on Morpho for USDG loans
Ledger Wallet launches crypto-backed stablecoin loans running on Morpho markets
About 973K MORPHO stolen from two institution-linked addresses and routed to Tornado Cash; no protocol bug confirmed

DOT.summary: Negative headlines support the short: the Fearless Wallet extension leaked seed phrases, and the JAM migration still has no mainnet date. No vesting unlocks; issuance runs at about 55M DOT a year under the hard cap.

news.title: Fearless Wallet extension found leaking recovery phrases; users told to move funds after about 17K DOT taken
Polkadot publishes a JAM migration roadmap with no mainnet date
Relay chain nearly emptied after the Asset Hub migration; a referendum to rename to JAM fails

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window and sources disagree on its size.

ANIME.summary: No material news this week. About 55% of the 10B supply circulates; Tokenomist shows no unlocks in the next 14 days (the next listed, to Community Cultivation, is Nov 23, outside the window).

WLFI.summary: USD1 supply shrank about 9% in two weeks, and a shareholder suit over the UAE deals adds legal pressure; both support the short. Insider tokens are locked until about 2028, so there are no unlocks. The pending OCC charter for USD1 is an upside risk.

news.title: Circle shareholder files derivative suit naming Trump, WLF and Witkoff over $2.5B UAE deals
USD1 supply drops about $401M (9%) in two weeks, mostly from one BNB Chain wallet
WLFI's conditional OCC trust-bank charter draws fresh criticism from Sen. Warren
